tagline: Set in the heart of one of Seattle’s most exciting neighborhoods.
description:
Level South Lake Union
Set in the heart of one of Seattle’s most exciting neighborhoods, Level South Lake Union brings an unparalleled hospitality experience to the city with spacious, apartment-style suites available for nightly and monthly stays.

Prepare meals in your gourmet kitchen, enjoy the convenience of in-suite laundry, and make the most of your time with access to luxury lifestyle amenities including three pools, a basketball court, and sprawling entertainment spaces. And, with the best of Seattle just outside your doorstep, you’re close to attractions like Pike Place Market, Lumen Field, Climate Pledge Arena, and the South Lake Union waterfront.

Whether you’re seeking nightly accommodations or short-term housing that goes beyond lackluster hotels and dicey month-to-month rent apartments, come and discover the suite way to stay in Seattle.

Printed address (General Inquiries / Map): 110 Boren Ave N Seattle, WA 98109
Front Desk Phone: 206.455.9077
Reservations Phone: 213.457.8773
Email: reservations@stayinglevel.com

City destination / properties — South Lake Union card
Hotel Stays | Monthly Stays | Penthouse Suites
Set in one of the city’s most connected neighborhoods, Level Seattle South Lake Union offers spacious studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom suites designed for both nightly and extended stays. Enjoy fully equipped kitchens, in-suite laundry, 24-hour Guest Services, and access to expansive lifestyle amenities—all steps from transit, the waterfront, and downtown Seattle.

Seattle properties intro
Surrounded by unmatched natural beauty, Seattle is a dynamic city known for its thriving arts and culture scene, diverse neighborhoods, and deep-rooted passion for sports. From the iconic Pike Place Market and indie boutiques showcasing local artisans to the city’s celebrated coffee culture and fresh Pacific Northwest cuisine, the Emerald City delivers a refreshing West Coast escape in every season.

With a location in South Lake Union, one of Seattle’s most vibrant and walkable neighborhoods, Level Seattle places you close to the city’s innovation hubs, waterfront paths, cultural venues, and sports arenas. Whether you’re booking a nightly stay, short-term furnished accommodations, or extended-stay suites, Level offers more space, more flexibility, and a more comfortable way to experience Seattle.

Property Features
Nightly & Extended Stays
Welcoming nightly and monthly stays.
24hr Guest Services
Trusted, caring service available 24 hours a day to assist with local information, restaurant reservations, travel arrangements or anything else you might need to help you settle in.
Outdoor Pool & Hot Tub
Two outdoor heated pool, one indoor pool, plus hot tubs, steam and sauna.
Sports & Fitness
Get your sweat on at our fully-equipped fitness facility featuring premium cardio, strength and weight equipment, yoga studio and spin studio with Peleton bikes. Shoot hoops in the indoor court or have fun with the family on the indoor climbing wall.
Entertainment Spaces
Enjoy al fresco entertaining spaces with dining tables, fully-equipped BBQs, and lounge areas with fire pits. Indoors find private dining and lounge areas, games rooms and more.
Pet Friendly
All suites are pet friendly plus an onsite secure outdoor dog run and indoor pet spa. Pet fees apply.

A New Rooftop Restaurant Is Coming to Level Seattle
Opening this summer, Solette Seattle is Level Seattle’s new rooftop restaurant and bar. Designed as an upscale-casual space with indoor and outdoor terraces, Solette offers chef-driven cuisine, craft cocktails, and iconic views of the Space Needle and Puget Sound. Approachable and welcoming by design, it’s not fine dining — just a great spot to gather, linger, and come back to again and again.

Suites
Experience the suite life in Seattle South Lake Union with dedicated Guest Services and unrivaled amenities. Enjoy a fully-equipped kitchen, spacious living area, personal outdoor balconies or patio and private bedroom, whether you require a shorter stay for multiple people, monthly studio rental for one, or something in between. Level Suites in Seattle’s bustling South Lake Union neighborhood provides the comforts of home with thoughtful conveniences like dish and cookware, in-suite washer and dryer, and premium appliances. Beyond apartments for rental monthly, with Level you can experience the thrill of getting to know Seattle without the hassle of trying to get simple day-to-day needs met.

Suites page
The suite way to stay in the city. Level Seattle – South Lake Union features spacious studio, one, two and three-bedroom accommodations in South Lake Union. Enjoy the comforts of home with fully-equipped kitchens, functional living areas, personal outdoor balconies or patios, and convenient in-suite laundry.

Stays that feel closer to home.
Amenities at Level Seattle - South Lake Union
Enjoy the convenience of our fully outfitted kitchens, featuring top-of-the-line appliances. Whether you’re looking to unleash your inner chef, or just want the peace of mind that comes with preparing your favorite meal the way you do at home, our kitchens have you covered.
Unlike traditional hotels, Level suites are thoughtfully designed with layouts that give you space for the things you love – enjoy a home-cooked meal in your dining area, relax with a family movie or games night in the living area, or kick back with your colleagues on your private balcony. Explore the city and return to your home-away-from-home.
Enjoy the convenience of a full-sized washer and dryer in each suite. Whether you’re away from home on business or traveling with kids, Level suites have everything you need to feel right at home.
Most suites feature open-air balconies – great for enjoying your morning coffee, soaking up some afternoon sun, or reading that book you’ve been putting off. At Level South Lake Union, Seattle has never felt so much like home.
Unlike other rentals, we respect your valuable time. Complimentary bi-weekly housekeeping ensures your suite remains a sanctuary, freeing you to focus on what’s truly important.

A streamlined home base in the heart of South Lake Union. This open-concept studio gives you space to unpack, prepare meals in a fully equipped kitchen, and settle in with ease. Ideal for solo travelers, couples, short stays, or extended visits that don’t require excess space—just smart design and comfort.
Your Level Suite is an open-concept studio made for easy days in South Lake Union.

Think mornings in the sunny kitchen, afternoons exploring the city, and evenings back home with room to spread out.
Built for shared stays without feeling crowded, the Two Bedroom Suite offers space to gather and place to retreat. Picture an early evening cooking together with fresh Pacific Northwest seafood, followed by a walk to Climate Pledge Arena for a game or concert. With generous living and dining areas, a fully equipped kitchen, in-suite laundry, and a private balcony, this suite works beautifully for families, colleagues, or longer Seattle stays.

Higher-level living with expansive city views and added breathing room. The two-bedroom sky suite features lovely interiors with a private outdoor space—perfect for longer stays, special occasions, or anyone who wants Seattle’s skyline as part of their daily routine.
Set higher above the neighborhood, the Two Bedroom Sky Suite pairs generous interiors with sweeping views that stretch across Lake Union and the city beyond. Start mornings with coffee on your private balcony, then settle into a day that flows between work, exploration, and rest. With a fully-equipped kitchen, in-suite laundry, and open living space, this suite is ideal for extended stays that call for both comfort and perspective.

A rare layout in South Lake Union, this Three Bedroom Suite is designed for groups who want together time without giving up privacy. Spend the day exploring the city’s music history, waterfront parks, or neighborhoods beyond downtown, then return to a suite where everyone has their own space to unwind. With expansive living areas, a fully equipped kitchen, in-suite laundry, and a private balcony, it’s a flexible option for families, relocations, or extended group stays in Seattle.

Space, light, and perspective. With elevated views and a larger footprint, this three-bedroom sky suite offers a refined setting for extended stays, family travel, or milestone moments. It’s a suite designed to feel calm, expansive, and unmistakably Seattle.
Designed for elevated group living, the Three Bedroom Sky Suite offers space, light, and views that capture Seattle at its best. Gather for meals inspired by the city’s food scene, spread out across spacious bedrooms with walk-in closets, then unwind together as the city lights come on. With a gourmet kitchen, in-suite laundry, and expansive living areas, this suite is a refined choice for extended stays, milestone trips, or families settling into Seattle for a while.

Whether you’re exploring Seattle temporarily or staying a while, gain access to over 70,000 sq ft of bespoke lifestyle amenities including 24-hour Guest Services, co-working meeting spaces, an onsite dog run—and two onsite pet spas—two outdoor pool, an indoor pool with hot tub and nearby steam and sauna, basketball courts, Peloton bike and spin studio, and more.

Retreat to your luxuriously appointed Level Suite for some quality downtime on your open-air patio or balcony or get cozy with premium bedding and robes. With Level’s “suite life” flexible lease apartments have never looked better.

Amenities page
Resort-inspired living in the heart of the Pacific Northwest
Life at Level Seattle – South Lake Union extends well beyond your suite. With over 70,000 square feet of indoor and outdoor lifestyle amenities, this is a place designed to match Seattle’s rhythm—active, social, and effortlessly livable.
Start the day with a swim or a spin session, take meetings from light-filled co-working and lounge spaces, then ease into the evening around rooftop fire pits or in the hot tub. Enjoy three pools—two outdoor and one indoor—along with a 9,000-square-foot fitness center, basketball courts, Peloton-equipped studios, and wellness spaces including sauna and steam rooms.
Outdoor dining areas with BBQs, generous gathering spaces, and flexible lounges make it easy to connect, while thoughtful guest services and apartment-style comforts keep everyday living simple. Level South Lake Union is also pet-friendly, with an on-site dog run and two pet spas, making longer stays feel seamless for the whole household. This is the suite way to live well in Seattle.

Ananya Spa
Wellness, right at home in South Lake Union
Located on the ground floor, Ananya Spa at Level Seattle offers a calm retreat just steps from your suite. From hydrafacials and aromatherapy massages to restorative treatments designed to reset body and mind, it’s easy to make self-care part of your Seattle stay. Guests can also explore VIP spa memberships with year-round credits and exclusive perks—ideal for longer stays.

A Sustainable Stay
Level Seattle South Lake Union is proudly LEED Silver certified, reflecting a commitment to sustainable hospitality, energy efficiency, and responsible urban living. It’s a stay that feels good—inside and out—while supporting a healthier future for Seattle and the Pacific Northwest.

Neighborhood
Located less than 30 minutes from Seattle-Tacoma International Airport, South Lake Union is one of Seattle’s trendiest and most walkable areas. As well as being a music town and nature destination, SLU is a foodie paradise. Packed with scores of hip restaurants, superb seafood, food trucks, and bakeries, its walkability is something to be thankful for.

The nightlife in Seattle has an energy all its own, from storied music venues that feel trapped in time to strangely special bars and taverns. To help get you started, Level locals have curated a list of favorite SLU neighborhood spots.

Staying a Month or Longer?
Designed for longer stays in Seattle’s South Lake Union, Level offers fully equipped kitchens, in-unit laundry, and ample space to actually live in — not just visit. Whether you’re relocating, managing an insurance stay, working a corporate assignment, or settling into a long-term project near SLU’s tech hub, our suites let you keep your routine intact while everything else is in transition.

Properties monthly stays
From fully equipped kitchens and in-suite laundry to spacious layouts and pet-friendly accommodations, Level makes longer stays feel effortless—whether you’re relocating, traveling for work, or simply staying awhile in Seattle.

Map, Parking & Transportation
Address: 110 Boren Ave N Seattle, WA 98109
Parking: On-site private parking is available for $47 USD plus taxes per day. Upon arrival, please enter the parking garage adjacent to the hotel entrance and pull a ticket at the gate. Continue down the ramp and turn right at the bottom to reach Level P1. You’ll find elevators through the glass doors to take you to the designated guest registration on the lobby level. — please use this space for temporary parking while you check-in. Enter the building through the lower lobby doors and take the elevator to the first floor. Our front desk team will greet you in the main lobby and provide your parking pass, which grants in-and-out access for the duration of your stay, along with instructions for long-term parking.
Public Transportation: Level South Lake Union is located a short walk from the Link Light Rail and various bus route stops. From SeaTac/Airport station, take 1-Line Light Rail to Westlake Station (approx. 36 mins) and walk (approx. 14 mins) to 110 Boren Ave N. Sound Transit Service Maps feature is a great resource for all of your transit needs throughout Seattle. Uber and Lyft ride sharing also operate throughout the city.
Getting Here from Seattle-Tacoma International Airport (SEA): Level Seattle – South Lake Union is 15.5 miles from SEA Airport.

Frequently Asked Questions
1. What are the Level Seattle - South Lake Union check-in and check-out times?
Early check-in or late check-out requests are based upon availability and may incur additional charges. Please inquire directly with the property you are staying at for check-in/out requests.
Level Seattle – South Lake Union Check-in: 4 pm Check-out: 11am
Arrival Information: Level Seattle – South Lake Union has an entrance on Boren Ave N. Use the front entrance to gain access to the building. Check in with Guest Services. You will be required to sign the Terms and Conditions and provide a credit card for incidentals.

2. What can I expect in my suite?
Fully-equipped kitchen with appliances, pots, pans, dishes, utensils and cutlery
In-suite washer/dryer and ironing set
Smart TVs
Wireless internet, local calling and voicemail
Heating and air conditioning
Premium furnishings and linens
Access to our lifestyle amenities and dedicated concierge services
Stays of 8 or more nights receive complimentary bi-weekly housekeeping

3. What makes Level Hotels & Furnished Suites different than a standard hotel?
The biggest difference is space. Our suites range anywhere from 475 square feet to over 2,000 and boast fully-equipped kitchens, in-suite washer and dryer and all the essentials to enjoy a space of your own while away from home. We specialize in both nightly and extended stays of 30+ nights. In addition to our portfolio of suites, the Level Penthouse Collection boasts an exceptional offering of sought-after penthouse accommodations in each of the cities we operate.

4. What is my reservation cancellation policy?
For nightly stays, reservations must be cancelled or modified 24 hours before a scheduled arrival date, or guests will be charged one night room and tax.
For extended stays, guests may be liable to pay cancelation charges of up to 100% of the negotiated rent for the balance of the term of the Accommodation Agreement. Please note that a change in the length or dates of your reservation may result in a rate change.

The Penthouse
Discover three luxurious penthouses nestled atop Level Seattle – South Lake Union. Inspired by the enchanting beauty of the Evergreen State, each penthouse residence boasts unrivaled views of the Pacific Northwest and refined finishes with soaring ceilings and motorized blinds. Revel in the grandeur of European-inspired kitchens with quartzite natural stone countertops and paneled premium appliances. Unwind in spa-like bathrooms featuring double vanities. Step into outdoor spaces designed for entertainment.

The Penthouse Collection at Level Seattle South Lake Union
Perched high above South Lake Union, the Penthouse Collection at Level Seattle brings together panoramic views, refined design, and expansive indoor–outdoor living—crafted for guests who want Seattle at its most impressive. Inspired by the natural drama of the Evergreen State, each residence offers a private retreat where city energy meets calm, considered luxury.
With soaring ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows, and motorized blinds framing views of Lake Union, the Seattle skyline, Puget Sound, and the Cascade Mountains, these penthouses are designed for memorable stays—whether you’re here to celebrate, entertain, or simply settle in and savor the moment.
Three Distinct Residences, One Iconic Setting

The Cascades Penthouse — 3 Bedrooms | 4 Bathrooms | 4,479 sq ft
A dramatic residence designed to showcase the Pacific Northwest at its most cinematic. Two expansive outdoor patios overlook the Cascade Mountain range, creating a constantly shifting backdrop from sunrise to dusk. Inside, a European-inspired kitchen with quartzite natural stone countertops and premium paneled appliances anchors the space, while an oversized island invites gathering, hosting, and slow mornings alike.
Perched at a vantage point, this penthouse offers two outdoor patios with sweeping views of the majestic Cascades mountain range, creating a live canvas that changes with the hues of the day. The Cascades Penthouse promises a daily spectacle of the Pacific Northwest’s magnificence.
Adorned with quartzite natural stone countertops, the kitchen exudes a timeless elegance. An oversized entertainment island serves as the centerpiece, providing ample space to embark on culinary adventures and host friends and family. Premium paneled and integrated appliances seamlessly blend functionality with sophistication.

Interiors Designed for Living and Hosting
Across our three penthouses, interiors balance luxury with warmth. Expect spa-inspired bathrooms with double vanities, custom millwork, premium finishes, and kitchens designed for real use—not just display. Indoor spaces flow naturally to outdoor terraces, making it easy to transition from dinner to drinks, conversation to celebration.

Celebrations & Private Events
The Penthouse Collection offers a distinctive setting for private receptions, corporate gatherings, holiday celebrations, and intimate dinners in the heart of Seattle. Flexible layouts and seamless indoor–outdoor flow support events that feel polished yet personal, all framed by sweeping city, water, and mountain views.
Built-in A/V capabilities, gourmet kitchens, and attentive guest services ensure hosting feels effortless from start to finish.
Event Capacity: Reception-style events for up to 75 guests Seated dining for up to 15 guests
Preferred catering partners are available, with outside catering welcome—allowing each event to reflect your vision.

A Private Way to Experience Seattle
Whether you’re planning a milestone celebration, hosting a discreet gathering, or indulging in an unforgettable stay, the South Lake Union Penthouse Collection delivers space, privacy, and perspective—all close to Seattle’s waterfront, arts scene, and iconic landmarks.

Seattle Penthouse Collection (properties)
Experience Seattle from above with the Level Penthouse Collection at South Lake Union—a trio of luxury penthouse residences inspired by the beauty of the Pacific Northwest. Featuring expansive layouts, refined finishes, and sweeping views of Lake Union, the Space Needle, and surrounding mountains, these penthouses are designed for unforgettable stays and elevated entertaining.
